decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The information shown on the submitted drawing, number 36425/OS/001, show satisfactory sight lines in line with policies T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments), and (T.2.2 Pedestrian Safety and Security), of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Following approval for demolition of the existing (former) London Transport Sports Pavilion and erection of new sports and social clubhouse with tied-caretaker accommodation at first floor level, together with reinstatement of bowling green, 3 tennis courts and 1 netball court, new 44 space car park, looped foothpath access to open space with new access to Great West Road details submitted pursuant to Condition 32 (access sightlines) of planning permission dated 15/03/2004.
